rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something belonging to a person and not shared.

example.english: This one is my own, not everyone else's.
example.traditional: 呢個係我自己嘅，唔係大家嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 m4 hai6 daai6 gaa1 ge3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say that someone owns or possesses something.
